configurePresets.name: windows-default
configurePresets.description: Native Vulkan build via vcpkg (manifest mode) and standalone LLVM Clang.

configurePresets.name: wasm-windows
configurePresets.description: WASM/WebGPU build via emsdk. NMake Makefiles, not Ninja -- Ninja can't invoke emcc.bat/em++.bat on Windows. Requires EMSDK activated in the invoking shell (see engine/scripts/emsdk-shell.ps1); no absolute emsdk path is hardcoded here.

configurePresets.name: macos-default
configurePresets.description: Native Vulkan (via MoltenVK, once linked) build via vcpkg (manifest mode) and Apple Clang.

configurePresets.name: wasm-macos
configurePresets.description: WASM/WebGPU build via emsdk. Ninja works directly here (unlike wasm-windows) -- em++/emar are real executables on macOS, not .bat wrappers. Requires EMSDK activated in the invoking shell (see engine/scripts/emsdk-shell.sh); no absolute emsdk path is hardcoded here.
